_comment: Read only by scripts/font-fallback.mjs (PORTS.md card 188). The site's tokens live in src/styles/globals.css; keep this font entry in step with --font-display there. The variable Bricolage package ships woff2 only, which the script cannot read, so it runs with --file pointing at the static @fontsource/bricolage-grotesque latin-400 .woff (same font, same metrics): see .claude/rules/styling.md, 'Fonts', for the exact command. The Bebas wordmark's fallback lives in src/styles/wordmark-fallback.css.

display.familyValue: "Bricolage Grotesque Variable", "Bricolage Grotesque Variable Fallback", system-ui, sans-serif
